description: Move the active layer by specified offset

deltaX.description: Horizontal offset in pixels (can be negative)

deltaY.description: Vertical offset in pixels (can be negative)

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

name: photoshop_move_layer
